rubrics.justification: Accurately identifies an early/poor-quality blastocyst with absent or unclear ICM and poor TE, consistent with 0DD; minor overinterpretation in suggesting morula transition and granular details not clearly verifiable from a single image.
Thoroughly integrates age, endometriosis, BMI, ovarian response, sperm parameters, endometrial thickness, and first-cycle status with embryo quality and prognosis.

Overall logic is structured, but the probability section is internally inconsistent: implantation is stated as 18–30%, yet clinical pregnancy is later given as only 6–10%, which should not be lower than implantation.

Generally aligns with Gardner grading interpretation and evidence-based IVF practice, including caution about add-ons and reasonable comments on PGT-A; some recommendations around endometriosis surgery/optimization are more conditional than guideline-driven.
Provides practical next steps for transfer, luteal support, follow-up testing, and future evaluation, though some suggestions remain broad rather than tightly prioritized for this exact case.
